title: Chapter 80: The Fifth Cubicle in the Toilet
html:
When did I pass twenty thousand views? There were only ten people here when I started.Chen Ge raised his phone toward the ceiling, but the signal remained weak. The chat lagged terribly: one moment no comments would load, and the next a flood appeared at once. He could barely follow it.

Twenty thousand views but fewer than five thousand followers. That ratio could be better.

Chen Ge photographed the sheets used in the Pen Spirit game, then turned the camera toward the broken ballpoint pen on the chair. “Dear viewers, can you see this? I played the Pen Spirit game until the pen itself committed suicide! Aren’t you going to follow me? Do you know how much I’m risking to be here? I’m an unknown host with no equipment and no team, walking the edge of danger alone. My gear may not be great, and I can’t even talk to you in chat, but I can bring you the most authentic supernatural experience. This is one of a kind. No one can copy it.”

After his speech, his follower count climbed. To Chen Ge, this was merely part of the black phone’s mission; to his viewers, especially those comparing him with Qin Guang, it was something else entirely. His equipment might be poor, but neither the danger nor the spectacle could be imitated.

Freshness and creativity were the keys to a successful livestream. Qin Guang’s team worked from a finished script and hired an actor for the role. No matter how convincing the performance, some moments would inevitably feel staged. Chen Ge’s content was different: even he had no idea what would happen next.

“Thank you for your support. That was the Pen Spirit game—please don’t try it at home. Now let’s move on to the next location.” Watching his viewership continue to climb, Chen Ge was delighted. Since he had to complete the black phone’s missions anyway, why not turn them into publicity?

I wonder what’s happening in the chat, but more viewers can only be good. At least tonight’s risk won’t go to waste.Completing the first side mission so easily boosted Chen Ge’s confidence. He put on his raincoat and left the dormitory; there was nothing more for him to do there.

There are three side missions left: the Sealed Classroom, the Deep Well, and the Fifth Cubicle in the Toilet.

The Fifth Cubicle in the Toilet had to be inside the education block. The dormitory toilets contained only four cubicles, and if the office building had a similar layout, only the education block fit the mission description.

Chen Ge checked his phone. He had arrived at Mu Yang High School at eight. The Pen Spirit game should not have taken long, yet it was already almost nine.

Three hours until midnight. One hour per mission. That should be enough.His plan was to finish the side missions as quickly as possible, then find a corner and hide until dawn.

Standing before the education block again, Chen Ge felt he was not facing an abandoned building but a giant coffin packed with corpses.

The side mission didn’t specify which toilet. This block has three floors, so any of them could be the mission location.Chen Ge switched on his flashlight and entered.

Passing empty classrooms at night made his skin crawl. Every time he looked back, he expected to see something that did not belong. He hurried to the end of the corridor and entered the first-floor toilet.

The fire had spared the room, leaving its interior much as it had been years ago. Weeds poked through cracks in the floor, brown stains marked the walls, and the single window creaked eerily.

“Focus on the mission, there’s no time to waste.”

Each toilet in the education block contained six cubicles. Years of abandonment had broken most of the doors, allowing Chen Ge to see inside without opening them.

Mallet in hand, Chen Ge inspected all six. Nothing seemed wrong with the first four, but the fifth and sixth caught his attention. Both doors were closed, and a cautious push revealed they were locked.

Normally, a locked door means someone is inside.That could not be true here. The school has been abandoned for three years. Even if something is occupying these cubicles, it can’t be human. I’d better take a closer look.

Chen Ge smashed at the sixth door with his mallet, and the door fell open. Before Chen Ge could react, several dark shadows charged at him.

“What is that?!” He leaped back and swung his flashlight toward his ‘attackers,’ only to discover a pile of cleaning equipment. Embarrassed by the false alarm, he gathered the fallen mops and brooms and shoved them back inside. The next cubicle held the same. All six cubicles on the first floor were normal, so the mission site had to be elsewhere.

As he left, Chen Ge glanced uncertainly over his shoulder. The cubicle doors creaked on their hinges like people waving goodbye.

That would make a great effect in the Haunted House.Chen Ge filed the idea away and climbed to the second floor. Its toilet had the same layout, but the window was boarded over. The moment he stepped inside, an oppressive weight settled over him.

This should be the place then.

Perhaps because its window had been boarded up, the toilet was better preserved than the one below and looked much as it must have years ago. He approached the first cubicle, but before he could open it, footsteps sounded in the corridor.

The rain made it difficult to be certain. Is someone running in the corridor?

He hid in a corner and raised his mallet, ready for anyone who rushed through the door. No one came.

As midnight approaches, the school is changing—slowly coming alive. I need to move faster.Chen Ge stopped hesitating and opened the first four cubicles in quick succession. As he reached the fifth, the footsteps began again. This time he heard them clearly: two distinct sets.

The mission description for the Fifth Cubicle in the Toilet stated that a red shadow would appear at midnight, was that it?
